facts.fact: A conference paper by University of Mauritius and Government of Mauritius authors trained a CNN on Satellogic high-resolution satellite images to classify agricultural farmland, urban, forest and barren land in the Black River district, at up to 99% reported precision.
facts.system: Deep learning analysis of Satellogic satellite images for SDG monitoring

facts.fact: UNCTAD says the Food and Agricultural Research and Extension Institute (FAREI) has been involved in CropWatch-ICP activities since 2021 and held a CropWatch training workshop on 18-19 September 2025 to build staff capacity in satellite-based crop monitoring and early warning.

systems.owner: AIRCAS (with UNCTAD and ANSO, via CropWatch-ICP)

facts.fact: The Mauritius Cane Industry Authority and MSIRI say they have used GIS and remote sensing for sugarcane field management since the early 1990s, and in 2024 were testing drone imagery to complement satellite imagery.
